name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: A Microsoft 365 outage on 12 Nov cut Outlook and Teams for about 10 hours worldwide; Microsoft says not a cyberattack
state: On 12 Nov Microsoft 365 services that depend on Exchange Online, including Outlook and Teams, were disrupted for about 10 hours for businesses and government bodies worldwide, with more than 130,000 US problem reports at the peak (Reuters). Microsoft said a large number of servers became unavailable and the load was not caused by a traffic surge; no cyberattack has been found (HCAMag). No effect on payments, airlines or emergency services was reported, so this is Watch, not Alert.
for_you: Email and collaboration tools may still be patchy as Microsoft completes recovery. Check the Microsoft 365 service status page and your IT team's notices before assuming a local fault.
rubric_hit: Watch: major cloud outage > 2h in past 48h (Microsoft 365, ~10h on 12 Nov); payments and airlines not reported hit

sources.title: Reuters via MarketScreener — Microsoft outage drags on for hours, disrupting Outlook, Teams for businesses and governments
HCAMag — Microsoft outage disrupts Outlook and Teams for businesses worldwide

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
